title: Apple's $95 Million Siri Settlement Equals 9 Hours of Profit
alt_title_1: Up to $20 Per Device: Inside Apple's $95M Siri Privacy Deal
alt_title_2: Why a Federal Judge Approved the $95 Million Siri Payout
description_hook: In Lopez v. Apple Inc., a federal judge granted final approval to a $95 million class-action settlement resolving allegations that unintended Siri activations recorded private conversations between 2014 and 2024. Apple denied wrongdoing, and claims are capped at up to $20 per device across five devices.

affiliate_cta.offer_name: Free 48-Case Lawsuit & Refund Dossier + Forensics Reading List
affiliate_cta.pinned_comment: Is up to $20 per device fair for 10 years of alleged voice recordings? Case filings and sources are in the description.

scenes.headline: Equals Nine Hours of Profit
scenes.narration: Apple's 95 million dollar Siri privacy payout equals just nine hours of its annual profit.
scenes.source: The Guardian Analysis of Apple FY2024 Net Income (Jan 2025)

scenes.headline: Triggered Without 'Hey Siri'
scenes.narration: Users alleged accidental Siri triggers recorded private talks, sending audio for contractor review and ads.
scenes.source: CBS MoneyWatch Summary of Lopez v. Apple Claims (May 2025)

scenes.headline: Capped at $20 Per Siri Device
scenes.narration: Apple denied all wrongdoing in settling, capping payouts up to 20 dollars per device across five devices.
scenes.source: Lopez v. Apple Settlement Notice (2014-2024 Class Period)

scenes.headline: Final Approval on $95M Deal
scenes.narration: A federal judge granted final approval in October 2025, ending six years of privacy litigation.
scenes.source: Lopez v. Apple Inc., No. 4:19-cv-04577, Final Approval (N.D. Cal.)

scenes.headline: Lock Settings, Don't Wait on Court
scenes.right_body: Turn off Siri audio sharing now
scenes.narration: Lawsuits settle years late for twenty bucks. Lock down your voice assistant privacy toggles today.
scenes.source: Lopez v. Apple Inc., No. 4:19-cv-04577 (N.D. Cal.)
